title: Defender for Cloud assessment
description: Provides a security posture snapshot from Defender for Cloud, highlighting critical findings and score trends.
example_prompt: "Pull Defender for Cloud assessment for all subscriptions: (1) secure score current and 30-day trend, (2) unhealthy resources by severity (high/medium/low), (3) top 10 recommendations by impacted resource count, (4) new recommendations in last 7 days. Prioritize by exploitability and blast radius."
